$comment: Ravenry's words, in English. Format: shared/README.md.
sessions.emptyHint: Start one in Ravenry on the computer, and it shows here.
session.handOffQueued: It hands off after the current task.
page.noSessionToAsk: No session is open to ask. The request is copied: paste it into one.
side.empty: Your sessions show up here, the ones that need you on top.
side.emptyNoBoard: Your sessions show up here, the ones that need you on top, once the board is running.
panel.pick: Pick a session on the left to see its context, hand-off and brief here.
panel.planBlurb: Hand work over as steps; it runs on its own and stops at your gates.
panel.noConversation: No conversation found in this folder.
else.moveNote: Move here ends it in {where} and picks up this conversation in a pane here.
else.otherDaemon: Its pane is in a ravenryd this window does not draw ({why}): read only here.
project.noEarlier: No earlier conversation found in this folder.
project.continuesIn: Continues it in a Ravenry pane:
project.movesIn: Move here ends it in {where} and continues it in a Ravenry pane:
project.gone: That project is no longer on the board.
start.title: New session
page.notNative: {page} is not drawn in this window yet.
page.notNativeHint: Open it in the Ravenry app for now.
checkpoint.answerHere: Answer it in the Ravenry app: this window does not hold its secret field yet.
checkpoint.ownWords: Or answer in your own words
checkpoint.openPick: Open it in the Ravenry app to pick side by side.
checkpoint.failed: The board did not take the answer: {why}
brief.title: Brief
brief.unreadable: The brief could not be read.
brief.entriesSplit: split into {n} dated entries, newest first
gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.src: {name}, {n} pictures its sessions showed, newest first
gallery.srcOne: {name}, 1 picture its sessions showed, newest first
gallery.none: No pictures yet. When a session shows one, it lands here.
plan.gone: This plan is no longer in the brief.
plan.noSession: No session runs in this project now.
newplan.drafting: {who} is drafting the plan. You read it before anything runs.
newplan.question: A question first
newplan.started: The plan is in the brief, and its session has it.
newplan.whatHint: Say it in a sentence or two. It runs step by step and stops at the gates you set.
newplan.from: It starts from the brief's plan
newplan.allDone: Every item of it is done.
newplan.fromGoal: The brief has no plan yet; it starts from its goal: {goal}
newplan.noPlan: The brief has no plan yet.
newplan.readFirst: You read the draft before anything runs.
newplan.sayFirst: Say what it should get done first.
idea.gone: That idea is no longer on the Ideas page.
idea.nothing: Nothing said yet. Ask anything about the idea.
idea.drawing: Claude is drawing a mockup round...
idea.reply: Reply to Claude about this idea
idea.mockupSent: A mockup round is on its way.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.src: When a session needs you and you are not looking
alerts.denied: macOS has not allowed Ravenry's notifications. Turn them on in System Settings > Notifications.
alerts.unconfirmed: On. The last one went through macOS's script {when}, with Ravenry closed: macOS may not have shown it.
alerts.notShown: On. The last one was not shown: {error}.
alerts.testUnconfirmed: Sent through macOS's script, with Ravenry closed: Ravenry cannot tell whether it showed.
alerts.phoneLine: Questions, picks and approvals reach you away from the desk
alerts.tgHow: Make a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste its token here.
alerts.whHow: Paste the webhook address from the channel's settings.
alerts.ntfyHow: Scan this with the ntfy app to subscribe to your topic{topic} on {server}.
alerts.ntfyQr: QR code that subscribes the ntfy app to your topic
alerts.newTopicDone: A new topic: subscribe to it again.
alerts.oneWay: Only one way at a time, besides Mac notifications.
pg.offTrust: Off until you trust this page
pg.offFixed: Off until the page file is fixed
pg.customized: Your copy is {path}. It is the one in the sidebar now.
pg.stale: Showing the last version that worked.
pg.fixText: The Ravenry page file {file} has a problem: line {line}: {message}{hint} Fix it, then run ravenry page check {file}.
pg.typedInBox: Typed in the session's box. Press Enter to send it.
pg.trustChanged: This page changed since you trusted it. Its buttons are off until you trust it again.
pg.trustNew: This page came with the project. Its buttons stay off until you trust it.
pg.trustChangedBy: , changed by a pull, an edit or an agent.
pg.trustAddedBy: , added by the repo, not by you.
pg.trustFine: Trust is for this version of the file. If it changes, Ravenry asks again.
pg.trusted: Trusted, for this version of the file.
pg.defaultChanged: Default page, changed since your copy.
pg.noGoodVersion: This page file has a problem, and there is no version of it that worked to show meanwhile.
pg.hiddenRepeat: Hidden until you say it again.
pg.writeBriefText: Write this project's BRIEF.md: its goal, what done means, and its plan.
pg.noGoal: No goal in the brief yet
pg.noPlanYet: The brief has no plan yet
pg.notDrawnHere: {view} is not something this Ravenry draws here.
pg.seed: Brainstorm: a seed, e.g. a cosy co-op game for the TV
pg.typeSeed: Type an idea, or a seed for 3 directions, first.
pg.thinking: Thinking up 3 directions. They land in Spark.
pg.nothingMemory: Nothing to suggest from project memory.
pg.approveTitle: Let this page ask an agent on its own?
pg.approveNote: It types and sends without showing you first. Ravenry asks again whenever the page file changes.
pg.into: Into {targets}. A backup is made first.
pg.changedTitle: What changed in the default {name} page
pg.changedNote: Your copy started from revision {from}. The default is now revision {to}. Your copy stays as it is until you change it.
pg.bringIn: Ask Claude to bring these in
pg.mergeText: The default {name} page Ravenry ships changed (revision {from} to {to}). Bring its changes into my copy {file}, keeping my own edits: the new default is {path}. Then run ravenry page check {file}.
dec.src: What you decided, in your words. Agents read this before they ask you.
dec.empty: Nothing decided yet. When you tell an agent how something should be, it saves your words here, and every agent reads them before it asks you.
dec.undone: Undone. The decision before it holds again.
dec.undoOver: The minute to undo it is over; you can still remove it on the Decisions page.
set.fontKeys: Cmd+= and Cmd+- change it for the open terminals
set.followOn: Light when macOS is light, dark when it is dark.
set.notTheme: That file is not a theme Ravenry can read.
set.cursorHint: Programs like vim can still change it while they run.
set.metaOff: Option types é, ü and • on both sides, as on a Mac anywhere else.
set.metaSide: The Option key you pick sends Esc+key, for Emacs and shell shortcuts. The other one still types é, ü and •.
set.metaBoth: Both Option keys send Esc+key, for Emacs and shell shortcuts. Neither types é, ü or •.
set.copyOnSelectBox: Copy text as soon as it is selected
set.linksBox: Open links with a single click
set.linksOn: A click on a link opens it.
set.linksOff: Cmd+click opens a link; a plain click selects, as in other terminals.
set.scrollbackHint: Kept by Ravenry’s daemon, so it survives a tab switch and a relaunch.
set.bounce: Bounce the Dock icon when Ravenry is behind
set.closingBox: Ask first when something is running in it
set.closingHint: An idle shell always closes at once.
set.someoneElse: A ravenry skill of someone else’s is there; Ravenry leaves it alone
set.skillsHint: Lets the assistant open panes beside it, read their screens, show you pictures to pick from and ask you through the board and your phone. Remove puts the folder back as it was.
set.hooksTitle: Tell Ravenry when it needs you
set.hooksOn: Tells Ravenry when it needs you
set.hooksHint: A line in the assistant’s hooks, so its sessions say here when they wait for you or hand off. Each file is backed up first; Remove puts it back as it was.
